newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends higher on technical firmness.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends higher on technical firmness.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended higher on technical firmness, but no sales were recorded as consumer demand remained weak, traders said.
"There was no news of business today," said a government trade source.

At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted the RSS1 buyer for June at 279 Malaysian/Singapore cents ($1.12), up one cent from Friday. The SMR20 buyer for June was also priced a cent higher at 263.50.
Traders quoted the SMR20 at 261, SMR CV at 332, SMR 5 at 272, SMR L at 307, SMR 10 at 262.50 and drum latex at 227.
